uses.label: Maronite Church (Antiochene Syriac Maronite Qurbono)
uses.finding: Printed sequence corroborated and extended: 1592/1594, 1608 variant, 1716, 1762 title with 1763 approbation (ONB copy acquired whole), Qozhaya 1816, 1838, 1855 and 1872, Beirut 1888 and 1908, Jounieh 1959, 1973 experiment (decree 43/1973), 1992 reform, and the 2005 second edition (decree 1512/2005) with eight anaphoras; complementary minister's books from 1596 and a 2008 Sharar booklet; dated manuscripts from 1454 onward identified through Gemayel 1965 and IRHT notices.
uses.limit: No collation of any two printed books; 1716, Qozhaya, 1888, 1959, 1973, 1992 and 2005 originals not acquired; manuscript images of BnF syr. 71-79 blocked; anaphora count of 1762/1763 unresolved.
next_sources: Count anaphora headings in the acquired ONB 1762 images (canvases 5-415)
Original 2005 Kitab al-Quddas (seminary Tl 188 Ar) title, decree and contents pages
A copy of the 1716 Missale Syriacum (Braidense GERLI.0740 or another holding)

uses.label: Shared West Syriac (Syriac Orthodox) ancestry used for comparison
